Celtic consider move for midfielder Ashour - gossip
- Published
Celtic linked with Egypt midfielder as Rangers prepare to offload striker...
Celtic are monitoring Egypt midfielder Emam Ashour, with the 28-year-old likely to leave Al Ahly in January. (George Tsarouchas, external)
Rangers are ready to welcome offers for North Macedonia striker Bojan Miovski in the winter transfer window. (Football Insider, external)
Sevilla are weighing up sending Scotland striker Robbie Ure on loan in January after spending £7.5m on the 22-year-old in the summer, according to reports in Spain. (Daily Record, external)
Napoli have met with Scott McTominay's agent in Manchester to continue talks over a contract extension for the Scotland midfielder. The 29-year-old's current deal runs until 2028. (Gianluca Di Marzio, external)
Glasgow's Ovo Hydro arena is the frontrunner to host the group stage draw for the Euro 2028 finals, co-hosted by Scotland, England, Wales and Republic of Ireland. (The Herald - subscription required, external)
MLS side Minnesota United have made an approach for Gretar Steinsson, who is the 49ers Enterprises technical director and a part of the recruitment team at Rangers. (Chris Jack, external)
Falkirk will let Ross MacIver leave in January, six months before his contract expires, with interest in the striker from clubs in England, Iceland and South Korea. (Daily Record, external)
Hearts head coach Wouter Vrancken thinks the Scottish football schedule can be worked on to lighten the load for clubs around European fixtures. (Edinburgh Evening News, external)
Celtic boss Martin O'Neill targets at least four Europa League points on the road against Torreense and Omonia Nicosia. (Daily Record - subscription required, external)
Former Celtic boss Wilfried Nancy is among those to have been interviewed for the vacancy at Swansea City. (The 44, external)

קבוצת סלטיק הסקוטית נמצאת במעקב אחר קשר מצרים אימאם עאשור, בן ה-28, שעשוי לעזוב את אל-אהלי בחודש ינואר. במקביל, ריינג'רס פתוחה להצעות עבור חלוץ צפון מקדוניה בויאן מיובסקי לקראת חלון ההעברות בחורף, וסביליה שוקלת להשאיל את החלוץ הסקוטי רובי יור. במקביל, נאפולי נפגשה עם סוכנו של סקוט מקטומיניי במנצ'סטר כדי להמשיך בשיחות על הארכת חוזהו של הקשר בן ה-29, שחוזהו הנוכחי נוטה עד שנת 2028.
